title: Success
description: Documented success code. The retained VSDC 2.0.6 sandbox campaign also returned 000.
fix: Inspect the endpoint response and required receipt fields; success does not establish central KRA acceptance.

title: Success (Reported VSCU JAR Variant)
description: Reported VSCU success variant; not confirmed by the retained VSDC 2.0.6 campaign.
fix: Use the success contract for the specific endpoint and runtime. Do not infer a signed receipt from this code alone.

title: Success (GavaConnect Variant)
description: Reported GavaConnect success variant; not the documented VSCU success code.
fix: Apply the GavaConnect endpoint contract, separately from TaxID receipt statuses.

title: No Search Result
description: No matching search results.
fix: Return an empty result for a successful query. An empty search does not prove a timed-out mutation was never applied.

title: URL Construction Error
description: Request URL construction error.
fix: Check the configured origin and endpoint path for malformed components or whitespace.

title: Header Construction Error
description: The specification describes an error while creating request header data. The code alone does not identify the missing or invalid field.
fix: Inspect client/library diagnostics and the headers required by the specific endpoint and runtime. Apply that endpoint’s authentication contract; do not infer a missing communication key from this code alone.

title: Request Body Serialization Error
description: The SCU library could not serialize the request payload.
causes: Invoice number sent as string instead of integer
fix: Invoice numbers must be sequential integers (1, 2, 3...) — not strings like INV001. Check all field types against the spec.

title: Server Communication Error
description: Communication with the server failed.
fix: Inspect connectivity and runtime health. A communication failure does not establish whether a fiscal mutation was applied.

title: Unallowed Request Method
description: The wrong HTTP verb was used for this endpoint.
causes: Incorrect method in SCU library call
fix: All write operations use POST. Check the endpoint method in your SCU configuration.

title: Request Status Error
description: Request status error.
fix: Retain redacted HTTP status and response metadata. Investigate fiscal mutations before considering replay.

title: Client Catch-All
description: Generic client error; the code alone does not identify the cause.
fix: Inspect redacted diagnostics and device state. Following a timeout, investigate the original transaction; do not infer a receipt from counters or replace its identity.

title: No Header Information
description: The specification describes missing header information. The code alone does not identify which field is absent or where the interface expects it.
fix: Verify the headers, device identity and authentication fields required by the exact endpoint and runtime. Retain the HTTP status, resultCd and redacted resultMsg to distinguish a client-side validation error from a control-unit response.
gotcha: OSCU v2.0 §3.3.2.1 lists cmcKey as required for code search, but the adjacent JSON sample omits it. That discrepancy does not establish that omitting the key returns 900, 901, 910 or 892. Earlier project notes associated 900 with an empty local VSCU cmcKey file; treat that as a reported runtime-specific observation, not a universal OSCU cause.

title: Not a Valid Device
description: The device is not valid for this environment.
fix: Verify the assigned device serial, taxpayer and branch with the operator and KRA registration. Do not copy another integration’s serial.

title: Device Already Installed
description: Documented installed-device condition (OSCU v2.0 §4.18; VSCU v2.0 §4.14). This does not guarantee identity/key data is returned or that the application is ready.
fix: For OSCU, verify the matching device identity and issued or retained communication key. For VSCU, verify the retained local device state and application checkpoint. If either is missing, stop for operator/KRA recovery; 902 alone recovers neither credentials nor readiness.

title: Device Type Mismatch
description: The device type does not match the verification path.
fix: Verify registered device type and configured VSCU/OSCU endpoint before requesting operator assistance.

title: Only OSCU Device Can Be Verified
description: Reported device-type mismatch outside the cited v2.0 response-code table.
fix: Retain endpoint, runtime version and redacted resultMsg; verify device registration with the operator.

title: Request Parameter Error
description: Request parameter validation failed.
fix: Use the schema and code tables for the specific endpoint. Read the field identified in resultMsg; tax classification and rates require current configuration.

title: Empty Request Body
description: Request body is missing.
fix: Check serialization and Content-Type. Retain redacted diagnostics rather than logging credentials or the full invoice.

title: Request Method Error
description: Request method error.
fix: Verify the method and documented route. The VSCU sale endpoint is POST /trnsSales/saveSales; no second saveInvoice call is required by the retained TaxID signing flow.

title: Code Value Error Among Request Parameters
description: Code-value validation failed. Observed in the retained VSDC 2.0.6 sandbox campaign on 2026-07-07.
fix: Read the field path in resultMsg and use its own code table: packaging and quantity units differ. The campaign rejected pkgUnitCd U and accepted NT.

title: Sales Data Rejected
description: Declared sales or invoice data could not be received.
fix: Inspect the request against the endpoint schema and retained runtime evidence. This code does not establish an undocumented two-call signing flow.

title: Sales Data Sequence Error
description: The response-code table describes invoice data received before sales data.
fix: Investigate the endpoint and runtime-specific sequence. Do not add a saveInvoice request to TaxID’s implemented sale flow or replay an uncertain sale.

title: Rate Limit Exceeded
description: Request limit exceeded.
fix: Back off read-only queries and cache reference data. For a fiscal mutation, investigate the original transaction before considering replay.

title: Error During Registration
description: Registration failed.
fix: Retain redacted diagnostics and investigate the affected record. The code alone does not authorize replay of a fiscal mutation.

title: Error During Modification
description: Modification failed.
fix: Inspect the existing record and operator evidence before repeating a mutation.

title: Error During Deletion
description: Deletion failed.
fix: Inspect the existing record and operator evidence before repeating a mutation.

title: Duplicate Record
description: Duplicate data was reported. This is not a recovered receipt or proof of identical invoice contents.
fix: Investigate the original transaction and obtain receipt evidence. Do not treat this code as signed success or create a replacement reference.

title: No Downloaded File
description: File retrieval failure in document or notice flows.
causes: Document no longer available on KRA servers
fix: Verify the document reference is current. Re-fetch the notice list to confirm the document still exists before retrying.

title: Unknown Error
description: Unclassified server error.
fix: Retain request ID, endpoint, runtime version, timestamps and redacted resultMsg. Hold uncertain fiscal mutations for operator investigation; exclude keys, headers containing secrets and buyer data.

title: Device / Branch Not Found
description: Reported device or branch lookup failure outside the cited v2.0 response-code table.
fix: Verify the assigned taxpayer and branch registration. No default branch is valid for every integration.

title: VSCU Memory Full
description: Reported runtime capacity failure outside the cited v2.0 response-code table.
fix: Preserve device storage and pending-transaction evidence. Investigate capacity and synchronization before an operator-approved restart.
